cards.text: Do your best impression of someone in this room — they must guess who.
Send a voice note to the last person in your messages saying only 'I need to tell you something.'
Let someone in the group post anything they want to your Instagram story.
Do twenty seconds of your best dance move, no music.
Call a contact named at the top of your favourites list and say you miss them.
Speak only in questions for the next three rounds.
Do your best catwalk across the room.
Text your most recent contact a song recommendation with no context.
Hold a handstand or wall sit for thirty seconds. Group counts out loud.
Let the group pick one item from your bag and you explain how it relates to your personality.
Narrate everything you do for the next two minutes in a dramatic documentary voice.
Let someone in the group change your phone wallpaper for the rest of the night.
Do your best impression of a game show host introducing tonight.
Swap shoes with someone for the next three rounds.
Let the group rename one of your contacts for the night.
Do an impression of a famous person — group must guess in under ten seconds.
Recreate the last emoji reaction you sent using only your face and body.
Let someone in the group read the last five lines of your most recent notes app entry.
Stand outside and wave to the next person who passes.
Reveal your screen time report to your friends.
Let someone else write your next dating app bio line.
Take a photo with a stranger using minimum words.
Eat a whole lemon slice with a straight face.
Chug whatever drink you have as if it's water.
Bump into a stranger and have a conversation for a minute.
Convince someone to do the Titanic scene with you.
